senses.gloss:
नुद् €6 U. (नुदति-ते, नुत्त or नुन्न, प्रणुदति)
—1 To push, push or drive on, impel, propel; मन्दं मन्दं नुदति पवनश्चानुकूलो
 यथा त्वाम् Me. 9; U. 5. 1.
—2 To prompt, incite, urge on; रथचरणसमाह्वस्तावदौत्सुक्यनुन्ना
 Śi. 11. 26; Ku. 6. 65.
—3 To remove, drive away, cast away, dispel; अदस्त्वया नुन्नमनुत्तमं
 तमः Śi. 1. 27; केयूरबन्धोच्छ्वसितैर्नुनोद R. 6. 68, 8. 40, 16. 85;
 Ki. 3. 33, 5. 28.
—4 To throw, cast, send.
—5 Ved. To raise, lift up. ━Caus.
—1 To remove, drive away.
—2 To prompt, incite, push on or urge forward. ━With {@उप@} to drive
 away, remove; Śi. 4. 61. ━{@प्र˚@} to dispel, drive off, remove; नयनप्रसरप्रणुन्नमिव
 वारिरुहम् Śi. 9. 71.
नुद a. (At the end of comp.) Pushing, impelling, driving away.
नूदः A kind of mulberry tree (Mar. पारसा पिंपळ).
